We need to produce a single command? The tool expects a single command string. We could do something like:

cmd_controller_execute({"command":"dir C:\\ > C:\\listing.txt && echo. > C:\\testing.txt"}) but we need to ensure correct quoting. Use double backslashes for escape. In Windows CMD, to create an empty file, you can use "echo.>C:\testing.txt". For listing all files recursively, "dir C:\\ /s /b > C:\\listing.txt".

But the user didn't specify where to store listing. They just said "list file in c drive and make file called testing.txt". Could interpret as list files in C drive (maybe output to console) and also create a file named testing.txt. So we can run "dir C:\\ /s /b" to list all files, and then "echo.>C:\\testing.txt" to create file. Combine with &.

Thus command: "dir C:\\ /s /b && echo.>C:\\testing.txt". That will first list all files, then create file. But if we want to capture listing to a file, we can redirect. But not necessary.
